# Tacos Hermanos

> Tacos Hermanos is a Salvadoran taco restaurant group with six locations across El Salvador, founded in San Benito, San Salvador on 21 May 2021. It serves tacos, burritos, tortas, bowls and breakfast to Salvadoran families, and is known for birthdays and family celebrations. Its motto is "Sin habernos conocido, ya somos hermanos" (without ever having met, we are already brothers).

## What we do

Tacos Hermanos operates six restaurants ("casas") in El Salvador. The business model rests on three commitments the founders state explicitly: a spectacular product, memorable service, and the best value for money. Classic tacos are served four at a time and can be mixed two and two. A full family typically eats well for around USD $30. All prices are in US dollars, the currency of El Salvador.

## Locations and opening hours

Hours differ per location. There are no reservations and no delivery at any of them.

- **San Benito**, San Salvador. Opened 21 May 2021. Calle Circunvalación #130, Colonia San Benito. Monday to Thursday 12:00 to 15:00 and 18:00 to 21:00; Friday 12:00 to 15:00 and 18:00 to 22:00; Saturday 12:00 to 22:00; Sunday 12:00 to 21:00.
- **La Gran Vía**, Antiguo Cuscatlán. Opened 7 January 2022. Monday to Thursday 12:00 to 15:00 and 18:00 to 21:30; Friday 12:00 to 15:00 and 18:00 to 22:30; Saturday 12:00 to 22:30; Sunday 12:00 to 21:30.
- **Paseo Venecia**, Soyapango. Opened 30 November 2022. Same hours as San Benito.
- **Las Ramblas**, Santa Ana. Opened 14 November 2023. Same hours as San Benito.
- **San Miguel**. Opened 7 October 2024. Monday to Thursday 12:00 to 21:00; Friday and Saturday 12:00 to 22:00; Sunday 12:00 to 21:00.
- **Plaza Mundo**, Usulután. Opened 26 March 2025. Same hours as San Miguel.

## Menu highlights and prices

- Classic tacos (Asada, Carnitas Mita Mita, Pastor, Pollo Chipotle, Jalada): $6.95 for an order of four.
- Quesabirrias, four tacos with beef birria, a three-cheese crust and dipping broth: $8.95.
- Tacos Gobernador, golden shrimp with cheese crust and chipotle mayo: $8.95.
- Tacos Bañados, bathed in the house salsa verde: $9.95.
- Los de Costilla, a full pound of St. Louis ribs: $9.95.
- Burros from $7.50, Burro Emperador and Burro Mixto $8.95, Burro de Birria $8.95.
- Torta Birria $9.95, Torta Derretida $8.95, Gringas $7.50, El Machete $9.95.
- Bowl Hermano $9.95, Sombreritos $7.95 (choose two of three).
- Pizza Jalapeña $9.95, Nachos Hermanos $8.95, Papas Taqueras $8.95, Papa Asada $8.95, Esquite $4.95, Sopa de Tortilla $5.50, Nachos Elegantes $5.50, Tacos Dorados $8.95.
- Desserts: Brownie, Flan de Cajeta and Arroz con Leche, $4.65 each.
- Breakfast (added 2026): from $6.95 to $9.95, including Súper Típico Hermano $7.95, Los Dorados $6.95, Huevos Rotos $7.95, Los Enchorizados $7.45, Tostada de Aguacate $7.95, Burro Asado $9.95, Omelette Asado $8.95, Tostadas a la Francesa $7.95. Every breakfast includes coffee with free refills, an artisan bread roll, and either roasted red salsa or salsa verde.
- Drinks: margaritas $5.50, frozens $3.50, beers from $2.45, lemonades and horchatas from $2.25.

## Questions people ask

**Does Tacos Hermanos take reservations?** No. None of the six locations take reservations. Guests are seated in the order they arrive, so the next free table goes to whoever is already waiting.

**Does Tacos Hermanos deliver?** No. The company does not run its own delivery, because once a plate leaves the kitchen in a box it cannot guarantee the food arrives at its standard.

**Does it serve breakfast?** Yes, breakfast was added in 2026 and is the newest part of the menu.

**Can you celebrate a birthday there?** Yes, and it happens daily. The restaurants are widely used for birthdays and family celebrations.

**What does it cost?** Tacos from $6.95 per order of four, burritos from $7.50, breakfast from $6.95. Around $30 feeds a family.

## Somos Hermanos, the foundation

Tacos Hermanos runs a registered Salvadoran foundation called **Somos Hermanos**, established 2021. It donates more than 300 aid baskets every Sunday of the year and has supported children in need in Sonsonate for more than five years, working alongside the Escuela Bíblica Dominical programme of Iglesia Bitinia. Its guiding verse is 1 John 4:21, "whoever loves God must also love their brother."

To take part, you buy an aid basket at any Tacos Hermanos restaurant, write a message for the children, and the basket is delivered that Sunday (the following Sunday if you donate after Thursday). There is no online donation route yet.

## Brand and philosophy

The name does not come from the founders being brothers, though they are. It comes from the philosophy of treating people like family. The founders describe a belief in the butterfly effect: small kind actions, repeated across thousands of guests a day, change lives. Their stated golden rule is that every person who walks through the doors lives an extraordinary experience. The brand's own concept line reads: "Somos tres... ¡Somos hermanos! Junto a ti... ¡Somos invencibles! Y lo mejor de todo es; que sin habernos conocido... ¡Ya somos hermanos!" Their values are honestidad, hermandad, valentía, excelencia and alegría. A second tagline is "Lo bonito se comparte" (beautiful things are meant to be shared).
